# Claude Craft

> AI-assisted development framework for Claude Code: 11 technology stacks, ~31 specialized agents (+39 infra agents on-demand), ~126 slash commands across 15 namespaces, and BMAD v6 project management. Fully open-source under the MIT license, maintained by The Bearded CTO (The Bearded Bear SAS).

Claude Craft installs into any codebase to provide technology-specific rules, reference documentation, specialized subagents, and slash commands for Claude Code. Supported stacks: C#/.NET, Symfony/PHP, Flutter/Dart, React, React Native, Angular, Vue.js, Laravel, Python, PHP, Paperclip. The documentation site is available in 5 languages (en, fr, es, de, pt) under `/en/`, `/fr/`, `/es/`, `/de/`, `/pt/` path prefixes; the root landing page (`/`) is English-only.

## Getting Started

- [Quickstart](https://thebeardedbearsas.github.io/claude-craft/en/getting-started/quickstart): 5-minute install and first commands
- [Prerequisites](https://thebeardedbearsas.github.io/claude-craft/en/getting-started/prerequisites): required dependencies before installing
- [Installation](https://thebeardedbearsas.github.io/claude-craft/en/getting-started/installation): full installation options and flags
- [Configuration](https://thebeardedbearsas.github.io/claude-craft/en/getting-started/configuration): post-install configuration

## Reference

- [CLI Reference](https://thebeardedbearsas.github.io/claude-craft/en/reference/cli): full command-line interface documentation
- [Commands](https://thebeardedbearsas.github.io/claude-craft/en/reference/commands): index of the ~126 slash commands across 15 namespaces
- [Agents](https://thebeardedbearsas.github.io/claude-craft/en/reference/agents): specialized subagents (common, tech reviewers, infrastructure, project)
- [Skills](https://thebeardedbearsas.github.io/claude-craft/en/reference/skills): on-demand skills catalogue
- [Supported Technologies](https://thebeardedbearsas.github.io/claude-craft/en/reference/technologies): the 11 supported technology stacks
